title: 第一卷 第28章 照镜子
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
张秋月给了他一个白眼。

    谁家好人会说自己是好人的？

    只有坏人会说。

    她和李华抠字眼理论。

    李华这会是真饿了，肚子咕嘟乱叫，只看到张秋月嘴巴一张一合，巴拉巴拉的，也不知道在说些什么。

    叽里咕噜的。

    他也懒得费心思去听。

    老板很快把海鲜面端上来。

    李华闷头就吃。

    张秋月要了瓶汽水，让李华帮忙开盖子。

    李华头也不抬：“没空。”

    张秋月气恼：“你以前都会帮我。”

    李华：“……”

    算了。

    和她说话，就得少吃一碗面，让肚子多饿一会。

    陈建走过来，喊道：“秋月，我来，我来。”

    他觉得李华很蠢。

    这献殷勤的机会都不知道把握。

    他把买来的海鲜放下：“老板，这些海鲜只做一碗。”

    老板应了一声。

    咔咔咔就处理起来，往锅里一扔，加水，加面，不需要加什么调料，海鲜面嘛，吃的就是一个鲜味。

    李华吃完一碗，说道：“老板，两碗。”

    陈建不傻，警惕的说道：“老板，一碗加我买的海鲜，一碗不加啊。”

    李华笑了笑。

    没说什么。

    很快。

    两碗海鲜面端上桌，一碗里鲍鱼虾蟹，海鲜比面多，陈建把碗往张秋月面前推了推，说道：“秋月，你吃。”

    张秋月也饿了。

    刚准备动筷子，李华咳嗽一声，说道：“秋月。”

    “关于你让我办的那件事情，我突然有了想法。”

    张秋月问道：“什么想法？”

    “这个想法很大胆，也很疯狂，总之一旦实现，绝对能让你满意。”李华说到这里，顿了顿，叹口气：“哎，这海鲜面里的海鲜太少了。”

    张秋月反应挺快：“我这碗里的海鲜很多，你吃。”

    李华婉拒：“这多不好意思。”

    “再说了，这是陈建专门买给你吃的。”

    “我吃不合适吧。”

    张秋月说道：“合适，他买给我吃，就是我的。”

    “还是算了。”

    “吃吧。”张秋月说着话，把鲍鱼虾蟹往李华碗里夹：“陈建，你有意见吗？”

    一旁。

    陈建嘴角抽搐，半晌憋出一个字来：“没有。”
content_en:
Zhang Qiuyue gave him a look.

    Which good person would say that he is a good person?

    Only bad people would say that.

    She and Li Hua were talking about words.

    Li Hua must be really hungry now, and his stomach is growling. He can only see Zhang Qiuyue's mouth opening and closing, babbling, and he doesn't know what he is saying.

    Chirping.

    He didn't bother to listen.

    The boss quickly brought the seafood noodles.

    Li Hua just ate without hesitation.

    Zhang Qiuyue asked for a bottle of soda and asked Li Hua to help open the lid.

    Li Hua didn't even raise his head: "No time."

    Zhang Qiuyue said angrily: "You have always helped me before."

    Li Hua: "..."

    Forget it.

    To talk to her, you have to eat less bowl of noodles and stay hungry for a while.

    Chen Jian came over and shouted: "Qiuyue, I'm coming, I'm coming."

    He thinks Li Hua is stupid.

    I don’t even know how to seize this opportunity to show my courtesy.

    He put down the seafood he bought and said, "Boss, I can only make one bowl of these seafood."

    The boss responded.

    Just process it as soon as you click it, throw it into the pot, add water and noodles. You don’t need to add any seasonings. The seafood noodles are just delicious.

    Li Hua finished one bowl and said, "Boss, two bowls."

    Chen Jian was not stupid, and said vigilantly: "Boss, add the seafood I bought to one bowl, but not the other bowl."

    Li Hua smiled.

    Nothing was said.

    soon.

    Two bowls of seafood noodles were served on the table. One bowl contained abalone, shrimp and crab, with more seafood than noodles. Chen Jian pushed the bowl in front of Zhang Qiuyue and said, "Qiuyue, you eat."

    Zhang Qiuyue is also hungry.

    Just as he was about to use his chopsticks, Li Hua coughed and said, "Qiuyue."

    "I suddenly had an idea about the thing you asked me to do."

    Zhang Qiuyue asked: "What do you think?"

    "This idea is very bold and crazy, but once it is realized, it will definitely satisfy you." After Li Hua said this, he paused and sighed: "Hey, there is too little seafood in this seafood noodles."

    Zhang Qiuyue reacted quickly: "I have a lot of seafood in this bowl, you can eat it."

    Li Hua declined: "How embarrassing."

    "Besides, this is what Chen Jian bought specially for you."

    "It's not appropriate for me to eat."

    Zhang Qiuyue said: "It's appropriate. If he buys it for me, it's mine."

    "Forget it."

    "Eat it." Zhang Qiuyue said, putting abalone, shrimp and crab into Li Hua's bowl: "Chen Jian, do you have any objections?"

    aside.

    The corner of Chen Jian's mouth twitched, and he held back one word for a while: "No."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 28 Looking in the Mirror
